calendar.noCalendars: No calendars on the mail server yet.
calendar.pick: Pick an event to see it here, or click a free time to plan one.
calendar.freeBusyDetail: When they are busy, not what they do.

event.room_declined: {{name}} declined: it is already booked or not yours to book
event.room_waiting: {{name}}, waiting for the room to answer
event.answerSeries: Your answer is for every time of this event.

dialog.description: Guests get an invitation by email, so any calendar app can answer it.
dialog.title: Title
dialog.guestsHint: Colleagues from the directory or anyone's email address.
dialog.locationPlaceholder: An address, or a link to a call
dialog.busyPublic: Busy, with details for those it is shared with
dialog.free: Free: it does not block the time
dialog.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start.

find.title: Find a time
find.detail: Busy times from {{from}}:00 to {{to}}:00; the frame is the time picked.
find.none: Nobody is free together for this long between {{from}}:00 and {{to}}:00.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Rooms and equipment are booked by inviting them to an event. A room accepts when it is free and declines when it is not.
rooms.failed: The rooms could not be loaded
rooms.noneDetail: An admin lists rooms and equipment in calendar.yaml:
rooms.unavailable: The mail server did not answer for this room
rooms.acceptsDetail: When free, up to {{days}} days ahead
rooms.answersDetail: What the rooms answered on their own.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: The company directory is everyone with a mailbox and cannot be edited here. Phones and mail apps get every address book over CardDAV.
contacts.descriptionIdentity: The company directory comes from Identity and cannot be edited here. Phones and mail apps get every address book over CardDAV.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.needName: Give a name or an email address.
contacts.groupDetail: A group is kept with its address book, so phones get it too. Invite it to an event at once.
contacts.filesDetail: vCard files from the old provider, or the address book as one file.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.description: Colleagues see only when you are busy, unless you share more. Team calendars are set in calendar.yaml.
sharing.shareDetail: They see it next to their own, and in their calendar apps.

apps.title: On your phone and computer
apps.description: Add an account of type CalDAV for calendars and CardDAV for contacts, with a device password.
apps.passwordsDetail: One for each phone or app; remove it when the device is gone. The same passwords work for mail.
apps.madeDetail: Type it into the device now: it is shown only once.

apple.name: iPhone and iPad
apple.1: Open Settings, then Calendar, then Accounts, then Add Account, then Other.
apple.3: Server {{server}}, user name {{user}}, and the device password.
apple.4: For contacts, do the same with Add CardDAV Account under Contacts.

mac.name: Mac
mac.1: Open Calendar, then Settings, then Accounts, and add an Other CalDAV Account.
mac.2: Account type Manual, user name {{user}}, the device password, server {{server}}.
mac.3: For contacts, add an Other CardDAV Account in Contacts the same way.

android.name: Android
android.1: Install DAVx5 from Google Play or F-Droid.
android.2: Add an account with a URL and user name: {{url}}
android.3: User name {{user}} and the device password.
android.4: Pick the calendars and address books to sync; they show in the phone's own apps.

thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
thunderbird.1: In the calendar, choose New Calendar, then On the Network.
thunderbird.2: Location {{url}}, with your user name and the device password.
thunderbird.3: Thunderbird finds every calendar you have, your team's and those shared with you.
thunderbird.4: For contacts, add a CardDAV address book at {{url}}

outlook.name: Outlook
outlook.1: Outlook on Windows needs an add-in for CalDAV, such as the open-source CalDav Synchronizer.
outlook.2: Add a profile with the URL {{url}}, your user name and the device password.
outlook.3: Outlook on the web and Exchange ActiveSync are not supported; the new Outlook for Mac reads CalDAV through the Mac's own accounts.

links.title: Subscription links
links.description: A secret address any calendar app can subscribe to, read only. Whoever has the link sees the calendar.
links.madeDetail: Copy it now: it is shown only once. Remove the link to stop it.

io.title: Import and export
io.description: Bring events from the old provider as an .ics file, or take a calendar with you.

leavers.title: {{name}} has left
leavers.detail_one: {{count}} meeting organised by {{name}} is still planned. Hand it to someone else, or cancel it, which tells the guests.
leavers.detail_other: {{count}} meetings organised by {{name}} are still planned. Hand them to someone else, or cancel them, which tells the guests.
leavers.dialogDetail: The new organiser gets each meeting in their calendar, the guests a new invitation, and the old one is cancelled.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The team calendars and rooms are set in {{file}}, never here.
settings.readOnly: {{file}} is the only way to change these
settings.readOnlyDetail: Change the file and keep it in git, reviewed like code; Calendar reads it again within a minute. A file with a mistake leaves the last good version in place.
settings.teamsDetail: Each team has a calendar and an address book its members see and edit.
settings.roomsDetail: Booked by inviting them; each answers on its own.
settings.fileError: calendar.yaml has a mistake; the last good version is in use
settings.syncFailed: The mail server could not be brought in step

sync.title: The mail server
sync.description: Calendar keeps the teams and rooms on the mail server in step with the file, after each change and every five minutes.

admin.accountDetail: Your name, password, second factor and sessions.
admin.membersDetail: Who signs in to Calendar, and who manages it.
admin.signinDetail: Identity providers people sign in with.
admin.tokensDetail: Tokens for scripts; they never read anyone's calendar.
admin.askAnAdmin: Ask an admin of Calendar if you need this.
